purpose: Durable handoff for migration to a new ChatGPT conversation without repeating closed work or relying on chat memory.
authority_rule: The new chat MUST read the stable pointer first and treat repository bytes as authority. This handoff is a resume map, not a replacement for the stable pointer.

scientific_firewall.rule: Do not open economic PnL, holdout or GA2 during migration/resume. GA2 remains closed until all 60 GA1 shards plus multiplicity preregistration are complete.

v235_hardening_in_progress.design_intent: Byte-pin stable pointer target plus integrity manifest through an acyclic chain: manifest -> target -> stable pointer.
v235_hardening_in_progress.resume_rule: Do not treat V235 as promoted until its integrity manifest, target and stable pointer chain exist and pass regression/adversarial verification. Until then V234 remains authoritative.

mandatory_new_chat_sequence: VERIFY: confirm its current_version, target_path and scientific firewall before any execution; if repository advanced after this handoff, follow the newer durable authority instead of forcing V234.
VERIFY: fetch the target pointer and all referenced authority/receipts/hashes. Do not use chat memory as authority.

HARDENING: inspect scripts/qros_cross_chat_resume_preflight_v235.py. If V235 chain has since been fully materialized and promoted, run that exact promoted preflight; otherwise use the stable V234 preflight referenced by the stable pointer and keep V235 as unpromoted work-in-progress.
EXECUTE: finish NQX/BUY/H4 using the existing 24/24 group artifacts or deterministic rematerialization to the frozen checkpoint roots; do not re-enumerate valid groups unnecessarily.
VALIDATE: run the V228 domain-bound merge, independent merge oracle, global mask preservation/oracle and pack checks; require durable PASS.
PERSIST: immediately promote H4 to FIRST_ECONOMIC_GATE_QUEUE after PASS, then update promotion ledger and frontier/stable pointers atomically/durably.
CONTINUE: move to the next canonical GA1 shard. Do not open GA2 until all 60 GA1 shards plus multiplicity preregistration are complete.
do_not_repeat: Do not repeat the 24 H4 group enumerations unless deterministic rematerialization is required by failed byte/hash verification.
Do not reopen the four already completed/promoted GA1 shards except for integrity verification/rematerialization required by durable policy.
Do not change frozen seed universe, alpha, risk, holdout boundaries, cost semantics or execution semantics as part of migration.
Do not infer a newer scientific state from this handoff alone; repository HEAD/pointers override it.
